currentRoundInspection.method: Inspected aerial picture pixels and standard viewer PMTiles bridge/water/terrain data.
currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected aerial picture supports pale inverted-Y pylons, stay fans, thin blue-edged roadway and approach piers. Retained mapped outline and current standard PMTiles Pont de Normandie bridge roads confirm the main-span midpoint, southward native+X, longer northern approach, width and full crossing length. Mapped main spacing860m is close to source856m and total2141m. A deliberately approximate-4.4m translation adapts the legacy CMH-authored height to a global sea-plane visualization; this is not a certified IGN69/EGM/tidal conversion. Bounded pylon/pier bases extend below the working water plane; mapped PMTiles water masks form the preview shoreline and raw surrounding terrain is retained. Approach road heights remain source reconstructions, with connected host road fitting requested.

references.redistribution: Reference only; no photograph or third-party geometry embedded.

limitations: Picture and standard viewer PMTiles approximate crossing fit; no bespoke survey or certified vertical/tidal datum transformation.

Original detailed source geometry and recorded hash remain reproducible; shared-texture wrapper applies-4.4m approximate shift plus bounded water-contact footings. Main-span/crossing dimensions and cable/approach geometry are retained.

Skyline merges paired fine stays into a few representative fans; closer reductions simplify cable hardware, rails and road markings. Shared concrete, stone and painted metal graphs; zero embedded images.

Mapped water flattening is a review fixture and host shore/tides remain data dependent. Road replacement requests connected approach fitting but exact vertical endpoint joins and real traffic are not surveyed. Footprint replacement off; physical-device timings unmeasured.
